The common area lacks enough dedicated work tables and seating for 25-30 tech enthusiasts to hack or workshop comfortably. Furthermore, the lack of confirmed multiple bathrooms/toilets and proper wellness amenities makes this a high-risk choice.
pros: Modern and bright aesthetic with natural light; Large open-plan common area; Well-equipped kitchen for group cooking
cons: Lack of sufficient seating/work surfaces for 25-30 people simultaneously; No dedicated sauna or hot tub facilities (only a fireplace); Bathroom/toilet count is unknown and likely insufficient for large groups; The preliminary data lists 'None toilets, None bathrooms' which is a major red flag
image_reasoning: The photos show a modern, open-plan living/kitchen area with ample natural light and wooden accents. The common room features a large dining table set for at least 8 people (visible in the first photo). There is no visible dedicated workshop or hacking space, but the overall size suggests capacity. The kitchen is well-equipped with modern appliances, including a full sink and cooking range. In the second photo, there is a freestanding wood-burning stove/fireplace, which serves as a heating element but not a traditional sauna. The photos do not provide clear evidence of multiple large tables or dedicated group work areas for 25+ people.
